llm.summary: This skill is a project-planning helper, but it can automatically pass brainstorming context into other skills/subagents and edit planning files without a clear approval checkpoint.

dimensions.detail: The core brainstorming and brief-generation workflow is coherent, but the artifact expands into required war-room deliberation, automatic specification handoff, subagent review, and automatic fixes to planning documents.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Triggers such as planning and requirements are broad, while the instructions require automatic downstream skill invocation, full context transfer, and no confirmation before continuing to the specification phase.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown skill instructions and modules only; metadata shows no executable bundled scripts, static scan findings, or VirusTotal signal.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Creating docs/project-brief.md and .attune/brainstorm-session.json is expected for a planning skill, but automatic chaining and subagent review increase exposure of potentially sensitive project context.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to project planning/session files, but the spec-review loop instructs the main agent to apply fixes to documents before surfacing unresolved issues to the user.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an opinionated, multi-phase planning workflow. Use --standalone or explicitly tell the agent to stop after brainstorming if you do not want context passed to war-room/specification steps or planning files edited automatically.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: The artifact confirms automatic war-room invocation and later automatic specification-phase continuation; this is related to planning but under-scoped for a brainstorming skill because confirmation is explicitly skipped.
[SDI-2] unexpected: The artifact confirms a bounded subagent review loop and main-agent document fixes. It is quality-gate behavior, but it delegates and mutates planning content without clear human approval.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad activation triggers are confirmed and materially matter because activation can lead to file writes and chained workflow execution.
[SQP-2] expected: Writing a project brief and session file is expected for this skill, but users should be aware that local planning artifacts may be created or changed.
[EA2] unexpected: The artifact explicitly says not to prompt for confirmation before continuing, which supports a Review verdict when combined with automatic skill chaining and document mutation.
